candidates.value: Silicon Power P34A80 internal SSD, model SP001TBP34A80M28, designed for consumers. M.2 2280 form factor with 1TB TLC storage and a PCI-Express 3.0 x4 interface. Offers up to 3400 MBps sequential read and up to 3000 MBps sequential write, with an MTBF of 2,000,000 hours. Features a super-fast PCIe Gen3 x4 interface for read/write speeds up to 3,200 MB/s and 3,000 MB/s, NVMe 1.3 support, and a RAID engine for improved data integrity. Slim M.2 2280 (80 mm) design for use in thin portable mobile devices or desktop PCs. Operating temperature 0°C to +70°C, shock resistance 1500G / 0.5 ms. Measures 3.50 mm high, 22.00 mm wide, 80.00 mm deep, and weighs 8.00 g. First available January 04, 2019.
